profile.name: Modbus串口通信接口
profile.description: 一种通过串行端口与支持Modbus协议的实验设备进行通信的接口装置，常见于RS-232或RS-485连接。实验中可用于配置通信参数，并与传感器、控制器、仪表等设备建立数据链路。
profile.description_en: A serial interface used to communicate with laboratory instruments that support the Modbus protocol, typically over RS-232 or RS-485. In laboratory use, it is used to configure communication parameters and establish data links with sensors, controllers, meters, and other instruments.
